cohort: 30 healthy pregnant women classified by delivery method
finding: Hemodynamic changes during labor differ based on delivery method, with vaginal delivery leading to increased heart rate, epidural anesthesia suppressing heart rate increase and increasing stroke volume, and Cesarean section decreasing heart rate and increasing stroke volume.
mod_finding: This study suggests that vaginal delivery with epidural anesthesia may be the preferred mode of delivery for most cardiac patients compared to caesarean section.
